subject: literature
passage: Lukas reached the station twenty minutes early and checked the arrivals board again and again. His older brother had been away at university in another city for almost a year. When the train finally pulled in, Lukas searched every window. Then he spotted a familiar wave from the third car. He had planned to act calm, but before the doors had fully opened, he was already running down the platform.
stem: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

choices.A: Lukas worries that his brother's train will be canceled.
choices.B: Lukas is so eager to see his brother that he cannot stay calm.
choices.C: Lukas plans to greet his brother calmly and manages to do so.
choices.D: Lukas's brother has decided to leave university and move home.

explanation.why: Every detail shows Lukas's eagerness: he arrives "twenty minutes early," checks the board "again and again," and searches every window. The last sentence confirms it: he "had planned to act calm" but is "already running down the platform."
explanation.A: Incorrect. He checks the board often, but nothing suggests he fears a cancellation.
explanation.B: Correct. His early arrival, constant checking, and running down the platform all show an excitement he cannot hide.
explanation.C: Incorrect. He planned to act calm but ends up running, so he does not manage it.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The text says only that the brother has been away for a year, not that he is leaving university.
